title: Cheesy Vego Cottage Pie
subtitle: Cook Once, Serve More!
description: Serve up more with our Feed A Crowd recipes! Using more hearty ingredients like filling carbs, proteins and veggies, you can satisfy extra hungry tummies or keep something for tomorrow’s lunch. If you’re on a 2-person plan, these recipes make 4 portions; on a 4-person plan, they make 8 portions.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Grease a 2.5L (10 cup) baking dish (see Feed A Crowd). Peel the potatoes and cut into 2cm chunks. Thinly slice the onions. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Coarsely grate the cheese. Drain and rinse the lentils.

Make potato mash: Put the potato in a large saucepan of cold salted water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 10-12 mins until tender. Drain, then return to the pan and mash until smooth. Add half the cheese and 20g butter, season with salt and pepper and stir until combined.

Simmer filling: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs olive oil in a large deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the onion and garlic, stirring, for 5-7 mins until softened. Season with salt and pepper. Add the lentils, tomato puree, tomato paste and 1 tbs sugar and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 8 mins or until slightly thickened.
Add peas: Add the peas to the filling and cook for 2-3 mins until the peas are tender. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Bake pie and serve up: Spoon the filling into the baking dish. Spoon over the potato mash and scatter with the remaining cheese. Bake for 15-20 mins until golden. Divide the pie among plates and enjoy!
Feed A Crowd: Instead of making one big pie to share, divide the filling among individual ovenproof dishes, then top each with mash, scatter with cheese and bake.
